records.text: Deborah and Jolene met for the first time on 2023-01-23 during a chat.
Deborah visited her mother's old house during the week of 2023-01-16 to 2023-01-22, which holds many memories for her.
Deborah's mother passed away a few years before 2023.
On 2023-01-23, Deborah shared a photo of her last photo together with her mother, showing a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair.
Jolene's mother passed away in 2022.
On 2023-01-23, Jolene shared a photo of her room in her mother's house, showing a room with a bench and a window.
Deborah's mother's house had a special bench near the window; her mother loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. Deborah sometimes sits there to stay connected to her mother.
Jolene has a pendant that reminds her of her mother; her mother gave it to her in 2010 in Paris.
On 2023-01-23, Jolene shared a photo of a heart-shaped pendant with a bird on it.
Jolene's pendant has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for her; it reminds her to go for her goals and not get held back.
Jolene believes that staying connected is super important.
Deborah also has a pendant that reminds her of her mother.
Deborah's goal is to keep teaching yoga and supporting her community.
Deborah is passionate about helping people find peace and joy through yoga.
Yoga helped Deborah find peace during a rough time, and now she is passionate about sharing that with others.
Jolene finds Deborah's story about yoga and her mother inspiring.
Deborah had to leave the chat on 2023-01-23; Jolene is looking forward to the next chat.

On 27 January 2023 Deborah told Jolene that Deborah's father had passed away two days earlier, on 25 January 2023; his sudden death left the family shell-shocked, and Deborah is channeling her grief by spending more time with family and cherishing memories.
On 27 January 2023 Deborah shared a photo of a woman hugging a woman who is sitting on a couch while discussing her father's death.

On 27 January 2023 Deborah shared a photo of her parents' wedding in 1993 — a bride and groom posing for a picture — saying looking back on great memories and family album photos give her peace during difficult times.
Deborah is married; she and her husband try to be as good a family as her parents were.
Deborah says love and openness have kept her and her husband close for years, and being there for each other has made them both happy.
On 26 January 2023 Deborah received a letter from her yoga group members thanking her for the positive influence she had on them; she shared a photo of the handwritten note on 27 January 2023.
Deborah is passionate about yoga, and moments like her group members' thank-you letter remind her why.

One of the places Deborah does yoga is her old home (her late mother's house); she shared a photo of its living room with a television and a window, and goes there now and then for her mom, who passed away.
Deborah finds peace sitting in the spot by the window at her old home, where she feels her late mother's presence and it comforts her.
On 27 January 2023 Deborah shared a photo of a window seat in a room with a window, describing the sentimental spot at her old home.
Deborah's mother would sit by the window every night with a book and a smile; reading was one of her hobbies, and it was one of her favorite places in the house.
Travel was another great passion of Deborah's late mother; Deborah shared a photo of the view of the sky from an airplane window.
Jolene has pet snakes; she showed Deborah a photo of her snake Susie, whose head was sticking out of a bed, saying her snakes always calm her down and make her happy.

Jolene told Deborah that while she was playing video games her second snake, Seraphim, slithered out of her cage and coiled up next to her, which she found funny; she shared a photo of Seraphim sticking her head out of a blanket.
Jolene owns two snakes: Susie and Seraphim.
Deborah believes having a pet totally brightens up your life and that it is great Jolene's snakes bring her comfort.
Jolene told Deborah that she bought a pet a year before 2023-01-27, i.e., around 2022, in Paris.
Deborah told Jolene that pets bring so much happiness.
Jolene described her pets as very unusual pets.

In the week before 2023-01-27, Jolene and her partner played the video game "Detroit" on a console together and had a lot of fun; Jolene described it as so fun and said they are both crazy about gaming.
Jolene and her partner are both crazy about video gaming; Jolene finds playing games very fun.
Jolene has a partner who games with her.
On 2023-01-27 Jolene shared a photo of herself and her partner gaming last week; the photo showed a person laying in bed with a dog watching TV.
On 2023-01-27 at 9:49 am, Deborah asked Jolene whether Jolene's boyfriend taught Jolene to play video/console games.
Jolene said she learned to play video/console games on her own as a child.
On 2023-01-27 at 9:49 am, Deborah asked Jolene whether Jolene only plays old games or tries new games.
Jolene and her partner are planning to play 'Walking Dead' next Saturday, which is 2023-01-28.
Deborah told Jolene to take care and keep spreading good vibes, and Jolene thanked her and said goodbye.
Jolene calls Deborah 'Deb'.
On 2023-02-01, Jolene told Deborah that her engineering professor gave her class a huge robotics project, which she found tough but fun, requiring creativity and problem-solving.
On 2023-02-01, Jolene shared a photo of a table with a robot on it and a laptop.
Jolene is an engineering student (she mentioned her engineering professor and a robotics project on 2023-02-01).

Jolene felt a mix of excitement and nervousness when she first received the robotics project, but by 2023-02-01 she was really enjoying it, likening it to solving a puzzle and finding seeing the robot come together awesome.
On 2023-01-31, Deborah met her new neighbor Anna.
On 2023-02-01, Deborah shared a photo of a yellow sign with a picture of a family.
Deborah and Anna met at yoga in the park on 2023-01-31.
On 2023-01-31, Deborah and Anna talked about how yoga improved their lives and the sense of community it gives.
On 2023-02-01, Jolene shared a photo of a purse with a plant on a table.
On 2023-02-01, Deborah asked Jolene if she had ever thought about resuming yoga.
On 2023-02-01, Jolene told Deborah that she planned to play the console with her partner.
On 2023-02-01, Deborah said it is good that Jolene has something to do together with her partner.
On 2023-02-04 at 9:48 am, Jolene told Deborah she had been on an emotional rollercoaster lately but was coping.
On 2023-02-04, Deborah told Jolene that she was all good and asked what was new with Jolene.
In the week before 2023-02-04, Jolene reached a major engineering milestone that went really well; she felt relieved and proud.
Jolene planned and researched extensively to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need; the project was tough but she loved the experience.

When Jolene saw her sustainable water purifier working and providing clean water to a rural community, she felt it was surreal and incredibly satisfying; it reminded her that engineering can make a difference and gave her a sense of purpose.
Deborah told Jolene she was proud of her and said Jolene's engineering skills made a difference for people in a rural area.

On 2023-02-04, Jolene said she wants to keep working in engineering and create sustainable solutions that make a positive impact on communities in need; her goal is to help make the world a better place.
Jolene loves engineering work that helps communities and is determined to keep pursuing her passions; Deborah's encouragement motivates her.
Deborah teaches yoga and says yoga is a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves; she spends much of her time teaching yoga.
On 2023-02-04, Deborah told Jolene she bonded with Anna, Deborah's neighbor, during a yoga class on 2023-02-03; Deborah shared a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah told Jolene that she and Anna tried different dance poses in yoga, including Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus; Deborah shared a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair.
On 2023-02-04, Deborah said the yoga/dance poses were difficult, but practicing them brought her and Anna closer; they supported each other, which meant a lot to Deborah.
On 2023-02-04, Jolene asked Deborah to explain how to do the yoga/dance pose they discussed, such as Warrior II or the chair pose.
Jolene is an engineering student who described herself as an engineer and had a major engineering accomplishment in early 2023.

On 2023-02-04 at 9:48 am, Deborah (Deb) explained a modified yoga pose to Jolene: sit on the edge of a chair with feet planted, twist the torso to one side, use the hand on the knee for support, hold for a few breaths, then switch sides; it is good for relaxing tense muscles.
On 2023-02-04, Jolene shared a photo of her bookshelf containing a lot of books with Deborah.
Jolene is really into the book 'Sapiens', finding it a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected humans; it gives her a lot to think about.
Jolene read 'Avalanche' by Neal Stephenson in one sitting around 2023-01-21 (two weeks before 2023-02-04).
Jolene read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges; it showed her that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.
Deborah commented that stories can be so powerful—they can teach, motivate, and bring people together.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah shared a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table; the bouquet was given to her by a friend when she was struggling, and it gives her hope and courage, filling her with warmth and appreciation.
Deborah's favorite nature spots are a park with a forest trail, which she finds calming, and a nearby beach where the sound of the waves and sand under her feet make her feel peaceful and happy.

Jolene shared a photo taken on her vacation in the summer of 2022 in Bogota, showing a person walking on a beach with a surfboard at sunset over the water; she found it beautiful and calming and it made her appreciate nature's calming power.

Deborah likes to visit a spot by the water near her mom's old house to reflect on her mom's life and find peace; being surrounded by nature helps a lot. On 2023-02-04 she shared a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water.

Deborah's tradition when reflecting on her mom at the spot by the water is to bring an amulet from her mom; it makes her feel her mom's love and stay close, and holding it brings her comfort. On 2023-02-04 she shared a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace.
Anna, Deborah's neighbor, also has a pendant she wears in memory of her mother; sharing this brought Deborah and Anna closer.

Deborah told Jolene that even small things can make a big difference and are reminders of the love and strength inside us, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us. Jolene agreed it can keep them close in our hearts every day.

On 2023-02-04, Deborah encouraged Jolene: 'Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!' Jolene replied that Deborah's encouragement means a lot to her.

On 2023-02-09 at 9:03 pm, Jolene told Deborah that she had done a mini retreat on Wednesday 2023-02-08 to assess where she was in life; she described it as a great experience that gave her a new outlook.

At her mini retreat on 2023-02-08, Jolene achieved more than she had imagined and gained a confidence boost; she accomplished something with her engineering project by coming up with neat solutions and was excited about it.
Jolene wants to look into green technology and see how she can contribute, because she believes green tech could make a real difference in disadvantaged areas.

Jolene has an idea for a volunteer program in which engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids; she is considering teaming up with local schools or centers to run workshops and inviting engineers as guest speakers. She has not yet reached out to any schools or centers because she wants to solidify the plan first.

Deborah responded supportively to Jolene's volunteer STEM program idea, saying it was a great way to help and inspire others and that kids would benefit from Jolene's knowledge; Deborah asked about the plan and whether Jolene had contacted schools or centers, and offered tips or information.
Jolene shared a photo with Deborah of her planner/notebook: a pen and a notebook page with notes or sketches for her plans.
Jolene thanked Deborah for her support, said she would keep Deborah posted, and Deborah replied that Jolene was awesome too.
On 2023-02-09, Jolene noted it had been a few days since she and Deborah last talked.
On 2023-02-21, Jolene had dinner and drinks with friends on a night out; she shared a photo of a plate of food and a glass of wine and said she was glad to let her hair down.
On 2023-02-22, Deborah visited a calming, nostalgic place and shared a photo of a garden with flowers in buckets.
Deborah finds roses and dahlias bring her peace.
Deborah lost a friend last week, around 2023-02-13 to 2023-02-19, and has been spending time in the garden for comfort.
Deborah says her friend's death has been tough, but memories comfort her and remind her how special life is.
Jolene says memories can give comfort and joy.
Deborah and Karlie were friends; Karlie died around 2023-02-13 to 2023-02-19.

Deborah shared what she called her last photo with Karlie, taken last summer in 2022 when they hiked; the photo shows two women riding a motorcycle on a dirt road, and Deborah smiles whenever she sees it.
Deborah traveled to Bali in 2022; she called it one of her favorite places, a gorgeous island that gave her peace and was great for yoga.
Deborah shared a photo of a swing on a beach with a blue sky from her Bali trip.
Jolene has been wanting to try yoga on the beach.
Deborah thinks beach yoga is wonderful because of the sound of the waves and the fresh air.
Jolene intends to try beach yoga; she said it sounds peaceful and will keep Deborah posted if she decides to go there.

On 2023-02-25 at 4:50 pm, Jolene told Deborah that since they last talked, balancing engineering school with Jolene's partner's video games has been a challenge, but Jolene sets aside time for yoga and meditation to feel calm amid the craziness.
Jolene practices yoga and meditation; they help Jolene chill out, gain perspective, and feel more alert and motivated.
Jolene shared a photo with Deborah on 2023-02-25 showing a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose.
Jolene's partner started joining Jolene for yoga sometimes, which Jolene says is nice for bonding and relaxing and has brought them closer.
Jolene shared a random photo with Deborah on 2023-02-25 showing a man and a woman holding hands with rings on them.
records.topic: Shared photo: rings and holding hands

records.text: As of 2023-02-25, Jolene and Jolene's partner are not married but have been together for three years; they are taking it slow and loving the ride. The ring on Jolene's partner's hand is a decoration, not a wedding ring.
Jolene met Jolene's partner in an engineering class in college; they quickly became friends, and it blossomed into a relationship.
Jolene shared a photo with Deborah on 2023-02-25 showing a book and a calculator on a table.
Jolene still enjoys working on engineering projects with Jolene's partner; teaming up feels great, they understand each other's struggles, and both love it.
Jolene shared a photo with Deborah on 2023-02-25 showing a group of men standing in front of a building.
records.topic: Shared photo: group of men in front of building

records.text: When Jolene is overwhelmed, Jolene takes a break and does breathing or meditates; it helps Jolene feel calmer and clearer and handle challenges more easily.
Deborah told Jolene on 2023-02-25 that it has been great to see Jolene's progress since they last chatted and encouraged Jolene to keep it up.
Jolene thanked Deborah, said Deborah's support means a lot, and said Jolene will keep pushing forward and continue taking time for herself.
Deborah shared a photo with Jolene on 2023-02-25 showing a person sitting on a bench looking at the sunset while reflecting outdoors; Deborah said it is a reminder to find peace even in chaos.
Deborah's daily routine includes morning meditation, yoga, and teaching classes, and evenings spent with loved ones.
Deborah went for a morning jog for the first time in a nearby park on 2023-02-24.
As of 2023-02-25, Deborah plans to incorporate a morning jog into her daily routine.
Deborah says exercise is key for Deborah because it makes Deborah feel connected to her body.
Jolene told Deborah that Deborah's jogging is a great healthy habit.
Deborah told Jolene on 2023-02-25: 'Can't pour from an empty cup'; looking out for ourselves gives us the energy to help others, and Deborah told Jolene she is worth it too.
Jolene told Deborah on 2023-02-25 that Deborah's words really mean something to Jolene and that Jolene will keep remembering to prioritize self-care.

On 2023-03-02, Deborah told Jolene that her neighbor Anna had gotten her a vegan stir-fry (tofu and vegetables with ginger and soy sauce) a few days earlier; Deborah found it really tasty and said food is a wonderful source of pleasure and nourishment.
On 2023-03-02, Jolene said her favorite dish is lasagna and that comfort food can be a great pick-me-up; she has a lot going on with her studies and exams.
On 2023-03-02, Deborah asked Jolene if she had been able to find time for herself lately.
On 2023-03-02, Jolene said she had been trying to squeeze in some me-time; on Friday 2023-02-24, she did yoga and meditation to relax. She shared a photo of a room with a wooden floor and a window.
On 2023-03-02, Deborah said she also did yoga and meditation and that it helped reset her mind.
On 2023-03-02, Jolene said it is amazing how a few quiet moments can work wonders for the soul, and she shared a photo of a purse with a plant on a table.
On 2023-03-02, Deborah asked Jolene if she had been able to get outside lately.

On 2023-03-02, Jolene said she took Seraphim (her pet tamed snake) to the park on Sunday 2023-02-26; Seraphim loved it. Jolene shared a photo described as a lizard lying on the ground surrounded by leaves, and noted that people are surprised when they see a tamed snake.
On 2023-03-02, Deborah said she likes being outdoors because of the birds chirping and the breeze gently blowing, and it reminds her of what really matters.
On 2023-03-02, Jolene said being outdoors is like a reminder to slow down and appreciate the little things.
On 2023-03-02, Jolene said she needs to be more mindful of her stress levels and take care of her mental health; sometimes she gets too caught up in her studies and forgets to prioritize self-care.

On 2023-03-02, Jolene said exams and deadlines had her feeling overwhelmed and that her to-do list seemed never-ending; she was trying her best but it had been challenging. She shared a photo of a desk with a notebook and a computer monitor.
On 2023-03-02, Deborah encouraged Jolene that her efforts would bear fruit and told her not to give up.

On 2023-03-02, Deborah advised Jolene to break tasks into smaller pieces and set goals; for time management, she suggested using planners or schedulers to stay organized and make time for herself. Deborah offered to help Jolene with a study plan; Jolene appreciated the help.
On 2023-03-02, Deborah said she will give Jolene a mug just like the one in a photo she shared: a yellow coffee cup with a handwritten message, saying it encourages.

On 2023-03-02, Jolene thanked Deborah and said the mug cheered her up; she wished Deborah all the best with her classes. Deborah thanked Jolene and was glad to bring a smile; she told Jolene to take care and relax.
Deborah and Jolene corresponded on 2023-03-13 after not corresponding for a long time.
Deborah hosted/taught a neighborhood yoga class for interested neighbors on Friday 2023-03-10; she said it was great to see everyone embrace and enjoy it.
Deborah shared a photo with Jolene of a group of women posing together from Deborah's neighborhood yoga class.
Deborah started a yoga class in her neighborhood and enjoys sharing yoga/exercise with neighbors and watching it transform them.
Deborah finds yoga calming and wanted to teach it to share peace and awareness with others; giving people peace and awareness brings her happiness.
Deborah believes teaching yoga helps others and has made her great friends and built community connections.
Jolene said life can get chaotic and that she is having a hard time dealing with her engineering assignments; she has a lot to manage and is struggling to keep up.
Jolene asked Deborah if they can still talk about time management; Deborah agreed to find a time that works for both, and Jolene said she will check her schedule and get back to Deborah.
Jolene said that having someone to rely on and support during tough times is motivating, key, and makes a difference in how life is handled.
Deborah told Jolene she is there for her, to take care of herself, and that they will catch up soon.
On 2023-03-22 at 5:35 pm, Deborah and Jolene talked after a while; Deborah hoped Jolene was doing okay with exams and deadlines and acknowledged it was difficult for Jolene.
Jolene finds trying to find time for everything stressful and like playing catch-up.
Jolene is using the Pomodoro Technique (25 minutes of work, 5-minute break) to avoid burnout but still struggles to prioritize tasks.
Deborah creates a daily schedule or to-do list; on 2023-03-22 she shared a photo of a notepad with a list of things to do as her example for that day.
Jolene tried making a to-do list but finds it overwhelming when there is a big stack of tasks; she shared a photo of a notepad with notes on it on a counter, an example from Friday 2023-03-17.
Jolene feels it is often overwhelming and difficult to figure out where to start when managing tasks.
Deborah uses a method when she is overloaded to figure out what is important and urgent so she is more organized; she later identified it as the Eisenhower Matrix.
Deborah explained that the Eisenhower Matrix sorts tasks into four boxes based on urgency and importance and is useful for organizing and prioritizing.
On 2023-03-22, Deborah shared a photo of a pair of scissors sitting on top of a piece of paper as a breakdown/visualization of the Eisenhower Matrix.
Jolene found the visualization of the Eisenhower Matrix helpful and thanked Deborah for sharing it.
Deborah suggested that Jolene try the Eisenhower Matrix to stay focused and less stressed; Jolene agreed to give it a go.
Deborah advised Jolene not to forget to take it easy and look after herself and wished her all the best.
Recently before 2023-03-22, Deborah and Anna sat by the sea, watched the sunset, talked about each other, and realized they inspire each other.
On 2023-03-22, Deborah shared a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard and asked Jolene what thoughts the sea in the photo made her think of.
Seeing the beach/surfboard photo made Jolene think of when she will learn to surf; she wants to find spare time to do it.
Deborah encouraged Jolene to chase her surfing dreams, not be daunted, and think about the steps she can take.
Jolene has been gathering information, watching videos, and got a beginners' guide to surfing; she needs to find the right time and place to get a surfing lesson.
On 2023-03-22, Deborah shared a photo of a row of surfboards leaning against a palm tree.
Jolene said the surfboard photos got her pumped to try surfing and she will keep pushing herself to make it happen.
Deborah reminded Jolene that the experience matters as much as the end result, to go step by step, and to have fun along the way.
Jolene thanked Deborah for the boost/support.
Jolene had a breakthrough on her engineering project on Friday 2023-03-24, finally finding a solution to a problem that had been bugging her; she felt great seeing her hard work pay off.
Jolene shared a photo of a person's hand holding a pair of scissors in her 2023-03-28 chat with Deborah.
Deborah told Jolene she had proven her skills and encouraged her to keep it up, and shared that she bought new props for her yoga class, with a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a room.
Jolene said she had new details for 'this case' and shared a photo of a cardboard mat with a cup of coffee on it.
Deborah bought a candle with a sprig of rosemary on it for atmosphere and to improve her yoga practice, sharing a photo of the candle on a table.
Jolene feels relaxed during yoga and loves creating a serene space with soothing scents like lavender and rosemary.
Deborah is a big fan of soothing scents; candles and essential oils add warmth and calm to her yoga sessions, and certain smells transport her to a place of peace.
Jolene finds music helps her yoga practice and loves listening to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds, whose calming music puts her in a different headspace.

Deborah likes instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms for a peaceful yoga vibe; one of her favorites is a track called 'Savana', and she also listens to an album called 'Sleep' for meditation and deep relaxation.
Jolene plans to check out Deborah's music recommendations ('Savana' and the album 'Sleep') for her yoga practice, and Deborah asked Jolene to let her know her thoughts on the albums.

On 2023-04-09, Deborah attended an art show with a friend in the afternoon; she found it cool and inspiring, and it reminded her of her mom. She shared a photo of a large brown and white photo of a person.
In the week before 2023-04-09, Deborah went biking nearby with her neighbor Anna; she found it freeing and beautiful.
Deborah's mom was interested in art and believed art could give out strong emotions and uniquely connect people. Deborah's mom is deceased.
Deborah finds going to art shows hard but comforting; it feels like she and her deceased mom are still experiencing art together, and it keeps her mom's memory alive, giving her peace.
Deborah believes simple things can bring the most happiness, and that finding solace in things we love, like art, helps keep memories of lost loved ones alive.
Jolene's snakes (Susie and Seraphim) can't chat or understand what she's going through, but her time with them is valuable and teaches her to take time and be in tune with herself.
Jolene relaxes by playing video games with her partner after a long day; this brings them closer together.

Jolene has been working on a big engineering project lately; it has been tough but cool to watch it take shape, and she can't wait to see the final result. She will keep Deborah updated on the project's progress.
On 2023-04-09, Deborah expressed support for Jolene's project, saying she is waiting to hear how everything turns out and that Jolene's support means a lot. Jolene thanked Deborah.
Jolene said losing someone is hard, but finding something that helps you cope is great. Deborah agreed this kind of comfort can be really helpful when times get tough.
On 2023-06-06 at 3:56 pm, Jolene told Deborah that she had finally completed her tough engineering project in May 2023 and shared a photo of a solar-powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back.
On 2023-06-06, Deborah congratulated Jolene on completing her engineering project and said Jolene's hard work paid off.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene said she was really proud of herself for sticking with her engineering project despite problems and finishing it, calling it a big milestone.
On 2023-06-06, Deborah asked Jolene what she had planned next after reaching her engineering project milestone.

On 2023-06-06, Jolene said she was interning at a well-known engineering firm; she described it as a great opportunity to test her skills and gain real-world experience. She shared a photo of a group of construction workers posing for a picture, identifying them as her new colleagues.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene said the best part of her engineering internship so far has been applying what she learned in school to real projects and seeing her ideas come to life.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene said her engineering internship has had a positive impact on her life, stoking her love of engineering and encouraging her to keep striving for her dreams.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene said hanging out with people who love what they do inspired her to stay focused and work toward her goals, and showed her that dedication and effort make anything possible.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene admitted that finding work-life balance during her engineering internship has been tough; she has been slogging away and finds it hard to make time for hobbies and chilling out.
On 2023-06-06, Deborah suggested Jolene take breaks and find relaxing activities like yoga to unwind.

On 2023-06-06, Jolene said she was trying to take breaks and shared a photo of a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched, describing it as an example of how she spent the previous morning doing yoga on top of Mount Talkeetna on 2023-06-05.
As of 2023-06-06, Jolene has been doing yoga and meditation sporadically for about 3 years, and they have had a real positive effect on her.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene said yoga and meditation have helped her with stress and kept her centered; she said she has no idea how she would have survived without them.
On 2023-06-06, Deborah said her favorite yoga studio is always very calming and shared a photo of a room with a bench and a window.
On 2023-06-06, Jolene asked Deborah for advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga.

On 2023-06-06, Deborah recommended Jolene practice mindful breathing for yoga: set aside a few minutes daily to sit with eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving the body.
Jolene planned to try Deborah's mindful breathing practice after Deborah's advice on 2023-06-06, thanking her and appreciating the advice.
Deborah offered Jolene more tips or help with mindful breathing if needed, on 2023-06-06.
Jolene said goodbye to Deborah, saying 'See you!', at 3:56 pm on 2023-06-06.

Deborah told Jolene she has been busy getting ready for a yoga retreat with some buddies, a chance to hang out with people who think like her and find peace and understanding; Deborah shared a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park.
Jolene said she has been super hectic with her internship and that Deborah's yoga retreat sounds awesome; Jolene could use a break.
Deborah tried a new yoga pose, Dancer Pose (Natarajasana), and shared a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach; she asked Jolene if she succeeded.
Jolene praised Deborah as amazing and shared new photos of Seraphim (Jolene's snake) in a new aquarium that Jolene bought on 2023-06-24; the photo showed the snake curled up in a plant-filled area.
Deborah asked Jolene where she got Seraphim; Deborah said she is always drawn to animals because they bring so much joy, and asked for the story.
Jolene said she got Seraphim (her snake) last year (2022); Seraphim is a great pet who always cheers Jolene up and brings a sense of peace; spending time with her is very comforting.
Deborah said pets really do make life more enjoyable and bright; Deborah shared a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a field.
Jolene said she is thankful Seraphim is here and that it is nice to have a calm creature around.
Deborah asked Jolene how things have been besides that.
Jolene said things have been intense lately; she is really pushing herself to succeed and sometimes feels overwhelmed, but is determined to overcome obstacles and achieve her goals.
Deborah advised Jolene to keep up the hard work and remember to relax too.
